events.title: European Shares Rebound As Yields And Oil Prices Ease
events.description: European stocks rebounded on Friday as wild volatility in bond and currency markets eased ahead of the all-important U.S. jobs report due later in the day.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed In Thin Holiday Trade
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed on Friday as investors grappled with wild swings in bond and currency markets.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the pre-European session on Friday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Flat To Higher At Open
events.description: European stocks are seen opening flat to slightly higher on Friday after U.S. stocks reversed early losses to close higher overnight, supported by a pullback in bond yields.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is maintaining its early gains in mid-market moves on Friday, reversing some of the sharp losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving above the 8,650 level, with gains in energy, financial and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Friday, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, as spiking global bond yields and crude oil prices renewed inflation concerns amid potential escalation in the US-Iran conflict after reports of the U.S. sending a third aircraft-carrier, jet fighters and additional 10,000 troops to the Middle East by the end of November.

events.title: Indian Markets Closed For Gandhi Jayanti
events.description: Indian markets remain closed today for Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti. Benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty fell 0.8 percent and 0.9 percent respectively on Thursday to extend losses for a fourth straight session due to continued selling by foreign investors amid elevated oil prices and global bond yields.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Extend Thursday's Gains
events.description: The Thai stock market on Thursday ended the three-day losing streak in which it had fallen almost 50 points or 3.1 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,560-point plateau and it may open to the upside again on Friday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market Overdue For Support
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in six straight sessions, tumbling more than 360 points or 5.4 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,000-point plateau and it may stop the bleeding on Friday.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Lower
events.description: The Japanese market is trading significantly lower on Friday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling below the 68,400 level, with weakness in index heavyweights and automaker stocks.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading notably higher on Friday, reversing some of the sharp losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving above the 8,650 level, with gains in energy, financial and technology stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Anticipated For Hong Kong Shares
events.description: Ahead of Thursday's holiday for National Day, the Hong Kong stock market had moved higher in two of three trading days since the end of the three-day slide in which it had given up almost 600 points or 2.5 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,610-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green on Friday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Friday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, climbing more than 700 points or 1.5 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 48,350-point plateau and it may see mild upside again on Friday.
